notes.title: What's next for Stationery Frontier
notes.content:
Hi everyone! As we successfully launch our first project on Steam, we can start working on the development again. As we start again, we would like to let you all know what is our plan for Stationery Frontier.

[h2]What are we working on now?[/h2]
[h3]LAN-multiplayer mode[/h3]
We are working on the LAN-multiplayer mode of the game. Currently, in the early access version of the game, there is a multiplayer connection page but there isn't any server for players to connect to. As we finish our server application, it will come as a free DLC to the base game, allowing players to host their own server and play with their friends.
[h3]UI overhaul[/h3]
We are also planning to change the UI of Stationery Frontier to make the screen cleaner and more visually appealing.

[h2]What’s the best way to contribute to the game?[/h2]
Find the game too difficult to play? Find some input control not user friendly? Let us know on Steam community or Twitter! We would love to know all the feedback and suggestions from our player to improve the project!
